head: codex/551-runtime-polis-config-owned-name-domain
title: [v0.92.1][runtime][observatory] Hot-load Polis identity and domain
body:
Closes #551

Adds a required validated Runtime-owned Polis identity and public endpoint contract, projects it through an explicitly negotiated Observatory feed, and renders the configured Polis name and domain in the HTML Observatory.

Every declared Polis parameter—ID, display name, public domain, Runtime API base, and Observatory public origin—hot-loads as one shared Runtime presentation snapshot without restarting the Runtime. The advertised Observatory origin must be accepted by the combined origin policy before startup or reload. Invalid reloads retain the complete last-known-good identity, API base, and origin policy and emit bounded redacted diagnostics.

REST and WSS preserve v2 for selector-free clients, provide an exact historical v1 projection for schema=v1, provide the identity-bearing v3 projection for schema=v3, and reject unsupported selectors. The HTML Observatory explicitly opts into v3. Unity #84 remains deferred and non-gating.

Focused proof passed: 76/76 affected Runtime integration tests, the Guardian v3 negotiation test, exact nonzero configuration/control/feed/OpenAPI/diagnostic targets, 3/3 HTML tests, Rust formatting, and diff hygiene. Independent exact-head and metadata-only reviews passed with no findings.
